FIX PUSHED as Gerrit change 2619 (commit a33b2aa76f74, 5 files, +162/-10): https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2619 -- awaiting gates.

RESOLUTION: 'make verify' = lint + typecheck + test, named in AGENTS.md as the pre-push contract.
Complete BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by enumeration: make test already carries CI's
DEFAULT_SUITE_MARKS, so there is no list to drift. That matters because my own proposed resolution #1
-- a curated 'make check-gates' -- would have reproduced the very drift defect this repo keeps
producing.

AND make check's HELP TEXT WAS CORRECTED rather than a third target minted. 'Run every check-only
gate (no mutation)' was itself how the false green acquired authority: a contributor reads it, runs
it, sees green, and reasonably concludes they have verified. Adding a fast tier would have built a
menu and invited picking the cheap item; deleting a false claim shrinks the surface instead.

MEASURED COST, quoted in make help, AGENTS.md and docs/local-dev-env.md: ~22 minutes
(19230 passed, 63 skipped in 21m57s; 22m25s wall including lint and typecheck), with
'-n 4 --dist worksteal' as the documented default and PYTEST_WORKERS to raise it. '-n auto' was
DISQUALIFIED BY MEASUREMENT -- it reached 7% in ~8 minutes, extrapolating past 100 minutes, because
much of this suite forks subprocesses. The repo had already reached that conclusion independently
(_build-and-test.yml:780 rejects -n auto for over-subscribing; docs/coverage.md:42-47 already
prescribes -n 4).

CONTROL RUN, which is the part that makes the timing claim meaningful: the pre-edit clean tree was
19229 passed / 22m13s. So the +1 test is exactly the new AC3 regression test and nothing else moved.

THREE RED DEMOS, each reproducing the exact bug signature (make lint = 0, gate = 1) and each
reverted: a stale mechanism-baseline entry, a dropped [ -f ] guard, and an added public symbol.

ONE OF THOSE DEMOS WAS CAUGHT BEING FAKE, which is worth recording as a positive: the first attempt at
the third demo used an UNDEFINED name, so make lint exited 2 on ruff F822 -- and a demo where lint
fails proves nothing, because the entire premise is a tree that lint calls CLEAN. Redone with a real
definition in isort order so RUF022 also passes. A green tick and a real proof are different things,
and the difference was noticed unprompted.

AC3 skew closed AT THE SOURCE and proven in three states: old tracked-only listing + unstaged = PASS
(the false green), fixed listing + unstaged = FAIL, fixed listing + staged = FAIL. The verdict is now
a property of the TREE rather than of the INDEX.

No ratchet fired and NO mechanism-ok marker was needed -- a Makefile target is not a ci_gate, since
that kind covers scripts/check_*.py files and workflow run: steps. Not closing until 2619 merges.
